arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM main.cards AS c
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND NULLIF(c.otherFaceIds, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND c.frameVersion = (
      SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
      FROM main.cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
  )
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT -1
